rationale: Record that regrouping test executables crosses the design-source-ingest selector without touching anything that family is about. The selector test/cmake/design_import*.cmake is crossed by test/cmake/design_import_view_widget_tests.cmake, whose 37 Catch2 suites are rewritten from one executable each into two grouped executables (pulp-test-group-design-import-widgets and pulp-test-group-graph-editor) through pulp_add_test_suite(... GROUP ...); the same change groups test/cmake/design_system_tests.cmake, which no family selects. Every ctest name and every per-test property (labels, timeouts, resource locks, environment, working directory) is preserved, verified by tools/scripts/ctest_inventory_parity.py against main with a declared map of one renamed duplicate case name, and the group mechanism now keeps hidden ([.tag]) cases out of a member's discovery exactly as a standalone suite did. No importer, DesignIR, fixture, screenshot, golden, capture, renderer, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
